Excellent next step, Shaan. Once CortexOS grows beyond a few agents, the biggest challenge becomes **schema consistency and discoverability**. Every folder should have a predictable structure so agents can navigate it deterministically.

# CortexOS Architecture (Mermaid)
![](data:image/png;base64,)
## Suggested Next Upgrade
For CortexOS specifically, I would add three additional production-grade schemas:

1. **Prompt Registry Schema** (prompts/)

2. **MCP Server Registry Schema** (mcp/)

3. **RAG & Embedding Schema** (vector-store/ with pgvector metadata)

Those three layers are what usually separate a demo AI OS from a scalable AI operating system.
